formula: ts_sum(16 * (close - delay(close, 1) + (close - open) / 2 + delay(close, 1) - delay(open, 1)) / (abs(high - delay(close, 1)) + abs(low - delay(close, 1)) + 1e-8) * max(abs(high - delay(close, 1)), abs(low - delay(close, 1))), 20)
